Polish usability and composition into a beautiful editorial legal workspace. Brand: clean white header, very pale slate #f5f7fa workbench, dark navy text, cobalt #2563eb primary controls, muted blue-gray rules. Inter UI labels, Times New Roman or similarly classic readable legal serif document text. Topbar exact ClauseInk wordmark atleft, filename "Studio Services Agreement" center, discreet "Demo document" label, "Saved" small status, "Export" secondary and "Save" cobalt button at right. Compact second-row real text formatting toolbar with font "Times New Roman", "12 pt", bold italic underline, paragraph alignment, list, undo and redo. Main left narrow document-outline rail with real section titles "1. Scope of work", "2. Deliverables", "3. Payment", "4. Confidentiality", selected Confidentiality. Main center 60% generously sized white paper document with real editorial typography, page margins, title "STUDIO SERVICES AGREEMENT", small line "SAMPLE · FOR PRODUCT DEMONSTRATION", fictional parties "Northline Studio" and "Meridian Collective". A few readable concise paragraphs with headings "3. Payment" and "4. Confidentiality". Exact brief sample paragraph: "The Client will pay the Studio within thirty days of receiving each invoice." Another: "Each party will protect information shared during the project and use it only to perform this agreement." Highlight only "use it only to perform this agreement" in pale blue; a small blue numbered margin marker connects visually to review panel. Right 29% pane tabs "Clause Library" and "AI Assistant" selected. Subtabs "Legal", "Content", "Writing" and "Results" active. Header "Review comments" then two composed clear suggestion blocks, no giant colorfulcards: first heading "Clarify permitted use", quote "use it only to perform this agreement", suggestion "Specify the purpose and handling of shared information." small replacement text "use it solely for the agreed project", buttons "Apply" cobalt and "Ignore" outline. Second "Define the return period" and concise suggestion about a return deadline. Everything should look intentionally designed, calm, credible, precise and highly readable, pleasing blue accents rather than generic enterprise blocks. Bottom small status "Page 1 of 3" and "100%". No fake compliance badges, guarantees, legal scores, e-signatures, seals, scales decoration, gradients, photos, fake analytics, laptop frame or perspective. All document content fictional demo, no legal advice claims.
